g.text: HOW: pin through BALL · ruler edge on the fan line · choose a power mark · roll 2d6 · put the ball on the edge above that colour tick
HAZARDS: water +1, drop back along this line on dry ground · off the board +1, play again · a line through trees stops at the trees
